The [[Botha Ammunitions Corporation]] maintained an '''orbiting station''' around the [[Dwi'kar's fifth moon|fifth moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Dwi'kar]] in the [[Kothlis system/Legends|Kothlis system]]. The [[Space station/Legends|station]] refined [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gases]] harvested from Dwi'kar and its counterpart, [[Dwi'lar]].
